item.tib: spyi spungs gab pa gsung chen las rgyal mo thugs kyi gzer bu'i tshogs kyi cha lag
item.coloph: de ltar spyi spungs gab pa gsung chen las/ rgyal mo'i thugs kyi gzer bu'i tshogs kyi cha lag yig chung 'di/ stag la'i thugs sprul dbra khyung sngags 'chang pa/ khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i thugs las sprul pa'i bu/ dbal 'bar stag slag can bdag gis rgyud lung gtsor bzhag nas/ cha lag 'thor bu bsdus shing bkod pa mu tsug smar ro//
